title: WaterSound 99 Compass Point Way S #203
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Dune Views- 2 Community Pools- Just Steps from the Beach- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: This 2-bedroom 2-bathroom condo in WaterSound Compass Point offers everything you need for a family vacation. The private views from the condo are beautiful, featuring dunes and sea oats. The kitchen has stainless appliances and granite countertops - a great place to cook a delicious meal. The living room offers a large flat-screen television, perfect for family movie night. The primary bedroom offers a king bed and an attached bathroom with a separate tub and shower. The kid's room offers 2 queen beds with an attached bathroom with a tub/shower combo shared by the hall powder room.Explore the area and walking paths that meander through the community. Just outside the gate is the 19-mile Timpoochee Trail that will take you to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Seaside, and WaterColor - all of which are within biking distance. Book now for your 30A getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower- Second Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom and Tub/Shower ComboWATERSOUND AMENITIES- Puttering Park (18-Hole Putt-Putt Course)- 2 Community Pools- DuneSider Grill Serving Lunch Poolside in the Summer Season- Bike and Kayak Rentals- Walking Paths and Meandering Boardwalks Throughout Community- Fitness Center (Fees Applicable)- Camp Creek Lake - One of the World's Few Natural Coastal Dune Lake-No Pets-No Smoking*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.Low-Speed Vehicles: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW. - Unfortunately, due to HOA rules, the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery WaterSound 99 Compass Point Way S #203 Watersound, FL Bedrooms 2 Beds 3 Sleeps 6 Full Baths 2 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Dune Views - 2 Community Pools - Just Steps from the Beach - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private deeded beach access - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: This 2-bedroom 2-bathroom condo in WaterSound Compass Point offers everything you need for a family vacation. The private views from the condo are beautiful, featuring dunes and sea oats. The kitchen has stainless appliances and granite countertops - a great place to cook a delicious meal. The living room offers a large flat-screen television, perfect for family movie night. The primary bedroom offers a king bed and an attached bathroom with a separate tub and shower. The kid's room offers 2 queen beds with an attached bathroom with a tub/shower combo shared by the hall powder room. Explore the area and walking paths that meander through the community. Just outside the gate is the 19-mile Timpoochee Trail that will take you to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Seaside, and WaterColor - all of which are within biking distance. Book now for your 30A getaway! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6): FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower - Second Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom and Tub/Shower Combo WATERSOUND AMENITIES - Puttering Park (18-Hole Putt-Putt Course) - 2 Community Pools - DuneSider Grill Serving Lunch Poolside in the Summer Season - Bike and Kayak Rentals - Walking Paths and Meandering Boardwalks Throughout Community - Fitness Center (Fees Applicable) - Camp Creek Lake - One of the World's Few Natural Coastal Dune Lake -No Pets -No Smoking *From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion. Low-Speed Vehicles: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW. - Unfortunately, due to HOA rules, the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart. *Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
